prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: multi-angle modeling reference for the existing Mira staff, not a game screenshot, not a technical dimension diagram. Input image is appearance reference only: preserve its worn dark wood, aged bronze, restrained pilgrim craft and part design. Neutral gray studio backdrop and soft even light. Show the SAME isolated small physical components from distinct front, true side, top/end and three-quarter angles, with no hands or surrounding figure. Shape and topology must be identical between angles. IDs only, no dimensions or arbitrary numerical labels. Do not redesign the completed staff, add ornaments, or include other components except a very small pale assembly-location thumbnail. Component rows clearly separated. The part shapes must be clear enough for a short deterministic 3D construction. THREE COMPONENT ROWS. S01: the single long subtly tapered wooden shaft of the source staff, without leather, metal fittings, lantern or hand; round cross section, nearly straight, the narrow foot slightly smaller than the top; show whole shaft and small end cross views without breaking it into extra parts. S02: isolated short hollow bronze foot ferrule sleeve with a modest rolled/beveled rim at each end, an open axial hole all the way through, no bottom cap. S03: a separate plain bronze bottom disc which closes that sleeve, flat underside, small edge bevel, no central hole. Assembled location thumbnail makes S02 surround the foot of S01 and S03 close S02 at bottom. In end view S02 is an annulus and S03 is a filled circle. All angles retain this.
